title: Beyond Behaviorist Representational Harms: A Plan for Measurement and Mitigation

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative case study analyzing an LLM's conversational outputs regarding sports figures to assess cognitive and affective representational harms, such as the exclusion of female, trans, and non-binary identities.

Conceptual analysis of algorithmic representations (e.g., evaluating hypothetical outputs where computer scientists are depicted exclusively as White or Asian) to assess the moral permissibility and psychological impact of stereotypical outputs.
